key.name: orchestrator-host
key.description: Host name or IP of the box running the orchestrator's heartbeat server, reachable over the VPN. Empty by default and deliberately so: an unconfigured extension says to set an address rather than polling localhost, which is never the right guess.

key.name: orchestrator-port
key.description: Port the heartbeat server listens on. 8787 is its default, and the same port HEARTBEAT_PORT sets for POST /heartbeat.

key.name: orchestrator-secret
key.description: HEARTBEAT_SHARED_SECRET, if the box has one. Only needed to *start* a cycle: reading the queue is unauthenticated. Empty when the box has none, which is how POST /heartbeat already behaves. Stored in GSettings, so anything in your session can read it — it is the same secret the heartbeat hook already holds in its environment, so this adds no new class of exposure, but it is not a vault.

key.name: poll-interval-seconds
key.description: How often GET /state is read while the menu is closed. The menu polls faster while it is open, and nothing is polled at all while the session is locked or idle.

key.name: always-show
key.summary: Keep the button in the top bar even when no cycle is running
key.description: Off by default: the button appears when a cycle is running and is hidden otherwise. Turning this on keeps it visible always, with the icon carrying the state, which is what you want if you would rather see blocked ideas without opening a terminal.
